meta.name: headless-browser
meta.description: Connects to Oxylabs remote headless browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) using Playwright or Puppeteer. Provides anti-detection, CAPTCHA handling, residential proxies, and geo-targeting built in. Use when browser automation needs remote execution, stealth capabilities, rendered pages, screenshots, PDFs, or complex JavaScript interaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 远程驱动无头浏览器完成网页交互任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要自动化浏览器访问网页但又不想被网站识别为机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Drive remote headless browsers to automate web tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need browser automation that evades bot detection.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可连接 Oxylabs 远程无头浏览器,自动完成网页读取、JavaScript 执行、截图和 PDF 生成,同时内置反检测、验证码处理、住宅代理与地区定位能力。
howto.when: 当需要远程运行浏览器进行页面自动化(含复杂 JavaScript)、截图/生成 PDF,或需要反检测与验证码处理时,Claude 会调用它。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com,把页面文字抓下来
say.note: Claude 会远程打开页面并返回正文内容。

say.text: 对 https://example.com 截图并保存
say.note: Claude 会调用远程浏览器截图并保存图片。

say.text: 抓取商品价格,遇到验证码自动处理
say.note: Claude 会启用反检测,并在需要时自动处理验证码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to Oxylabs remote headless browsers to automate web pages, execute JavaScript, capture screenshots or PDFs, and has built-in anti-detection, CAPTCHA handling, residential proxies, and geo-targeting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for remote browser automation, complex JavaScript page handling, screenshots/PDF generation, or needs anti-detection and CAPTCHA solving.

say_en.text: Open example.com and fetch the page text.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page remotely and return the content.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of https://example.com and save it.
say_en.note: Claude will use a remote browser to save the screenshot.

say_en.text: Scrape product prices and auto-handle CAPTCHAs when needed.
say_en.note: Claude will use anti-detection and auto-solve CAPTCHAs.
